novel_mechanics_found: The magenta-headed alternating-color line is an extendable/retractable chain rather than a decorative guide: ACTION1/ACTION2 move its row, ACTION4 extends it, and ACTION3 retracts it. A colored block is carried only when the endpoint has passed fully beyond the block; mere visual overlap is insufficient. Level 3 presents four vertically linked colors against a separate horizontal head-to-tail ordering strip.
narrative: The 44-action registry prefix was replayed from a fresh environment and reached levels_completed=2. I then analyzed rendered-frame deltas and banked-level montages, and tested forward target-order, endpoint-clearance, increasing retraction/extension, and reverse-order variants on level 3. None advanced the frame beyond level 2; I stopped after reserving enough budget for a fresh reproduction gate, which passed at claimed_level=2.
gotchas: Repeated env.reset() on the same sk48 environment changes the level-3 starting head geometry; branch and verify with a newly constructed environment.
A three-frame collision animation indicates contact, but contact alone does not mean the block has been threaded or the level has advanced.
The extension must clear the full four-pixel colored block before retraction can carry it; the required extension count depends on the current head and endpoint alignment.
The bottom colored chain is meaningful ordering information, not decorative UI.
